targets.queryText:
SELECT 
    path as metric,
    NULLIF(count(1) filter(where status BETWEEN 400 AND 499), 0) as "4xx",
    NULLIF(count(1) filter(where status BETWEEN 500 AND 599), 0) as "5xx",
    NULLIF(count(1) filter(where status BETWEEN 200 AND 299), 0) as "2xx",
    NULLIF(count(1) filter(where status NOT BETWEEN 400 AND 599 AND status NOT BETWEEN 200 AND 299), 0) as other
FROM 
    requests LEFT JOIN responses ON responses.reqid = requests.id
WHERE 
    runid = $runid AND
    path IN (${endpoint:sqlstring})
GROUP BY path

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', timestamp) AS time,
  CASE
    WHEN endpoint_coverage_total > 0 THEN 100.0 * endpoint_coverage / endpoint_coverage_total
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Endpoint Coverage (%)",
  CASE
    WHEN line_coverage_total > 0 THEN 100.0 * line_coverage / line_coverage_total
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Line Coverage (%)"
FROM
  coverage
WHERE
  runid = "$runid"
ORDER BY timestamp

  END AS "Endpoint Coverage (%)",

    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Line Coverage (%)"
FROM
  coverage

  otel_spans_late_after_eviction_total AS "Late spans after eviction"

ORDER BY timestamp
